scientific_scope_status: For N>=2 fixed positive reciprocal thermal-tree lumps, source-only initial energy and R=C_total/C_source>1, CV²>=1/[1+(N-1)tanh(log(R)/(2(N-1)))], sharply attained by positive ladders. Arbitrarily many lumps still require R>=exp(2(epsilon^-2-1)) for CV<=epsilon. A different autonomous single-reservoir memoryless curve g_min<=G(T)<=g_max with K=g_max/g_min>1 has optimum CV²=v, where 2(atanh(v)-v)=-log(1-1/K)-1/K; its low-to-high conductance threshold attains the bound in the measurable class.
